title: The Last Moving Employee
cues: On Monday, Max found his computer gone. His boss pointed at the wall. See that little light? Wave at it.
Max waved. Somewhere behind him, a printer came to life. His boss checked his watch. Perfect. Keep doing that till six.
Turns out, the new smart office had exactly one motion sensor. And somebody had installed it facing Max's desk.
As long as Max moved, the building knew people were working. At noon, he unwrapped a sandwich. Both hands busy.
The lights went out. Upstairs, twelve people sat in the dark. Downstairs, Max took a bite.
His boss came running. Max held out the sandwich. Hold this. He gave the wall one little wave.
The lights came back. The printer finished its page. It was Max's new job title.
Head of Motion. For the first time in his career, Max asked for a raise without lifting a finger.
